originalTitle: Is 'Trumpflation' real? Why Wall Street fears this could be a reason for stock market crash
simplifiedContent: There's a concern on Wall Street that something called "Trumpflation" could cause the stock market to crash. This worry is growing because prices are rising due to artificial intelligence and other factors. The core inflation rate is currently at 3.3%, which is considered high, and interest rates on government bonds are also increasing. This could lead the Federal Reserve to keep interest rates high or even raise them, which would make it more expensive for companies to borrow money and could decrease the value of their stocks. As a result, the high prices of stocks on the market might not be sustainable, which is why investors are getting nervous.

originalTitle: World Bank's IFC, HDFC AMC invest in Molbio Diagnostics' Rs 281 crore IPO anchor round
simplifiedContent: Molbio Diagnostics, a company from Goa, is planning to raise money by selling shares to the public, known as an Initial Public Offering (IPO), which will start on August 10. Before the IPO, the company raised Rs 281 crore from big investors, including the World Bank's IFC and HDFC Mutual Fund, in a special round called the anchor round. This is a good sign for the company, as it shows that these big investors are interested in buying its shares. Additionally, some brokerages are recommending that people buy shares in this IPO, and the company also made some secondary deals worth Rs 160 crore. This investment from big investors could make the IPO more attractive to other investors.

originalTitle: Market Trading Guide: Jindal Saw among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: Some companies in the stock market have recently reported their earnings, and most of them have done as well as or even better than expected. This is making investors feel more positive about certain sectors of the market. As a result, some experts are recommending that investors consider buying specific stocks, including Jindal Saw, on Monday. This might be a good opportunity for investors to make some money. The recommendation is based on the positive earnings reports and the resulting optimism in the market.

originalTitle: The stock market is finally rising again—and it’s getting cheaper, too
simplifiedContent: The stock market, which is measured by the S&P 500, has gone up by 22% over the past year. This means that the value of the stocks in the market has increased. Even though the market is going up, the price of investing in it has actually become cheaper, which is known as valuations coming down. This is a positive sign for investors because it means they can buy into the market at a relatively lower cost. This change could be a good opportunity for investors to put their money into the market.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Shiprocket IPO, Dhoot Transmission IPO among new issues to open next week; full list here
simplifiedContent: Some companies, including Shiprocket and Dhoot Transmission, are planning to sell their shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means people can buy their shares starting from August 10 to 12. At the same time, eight other companies that recently sold their shares will start trading on the market. This is important because it gives investors a chance to buy into new companies and potentially make money if their shares do well. These new shares can be a good opportunity for investors to diversify their investments and potentially earn returns.

originalTitle: Defence stock Apollo Micro Systems declares Q1 results 2026. Revenue jumps 88% YoY to  ₹251 crore, PAT up 43%
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes products for the defense industry, just released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The company's revenue, which is the amount of money it made from selling its products, increased by 88% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹251 crore. Its net profit, which is the amount of money the company has left after paying all its expenses, also increased by 43% to ₹25.2 crore. This means the company is making more money and is more profitable than it was a year ago. This is important because it shows that the company is growing and performing well, which can be good news for people who invest in the company's stock.
